chunks.text: TXT source states that directory grant alpha-tanager must exist before external folder ingestion reads operator files.
TXT CLI notes say command exit code zero means the requested local workflow completed successfully.
TXT memory policy keeps preference notes separate from cited source evidence in answer traces.
Markdown release notes record local release, source artifact, Python distribution, retrieval quality, and fresh clone receipts.
Markdown tool policy requires approval record beta-tern before an allowlisted local tool call can execute.
Markdown governance summary says GitHub startup failure with zero jobs blocks governed release readiness.
HTML parser keeps page title metadata and visible body text while excluding script and style content.
HTML source manifest records link count, text length, parser warnings, byte count, source path, and file hash.
HTML local document chunks preserve cited source lineage through source ID and chunk ID bindings.
DOCX parser extracts paragraph text from word document XML and stores paragraph count in metadata.
DOCX table rows are rendered as pipe separated cell text so tabular evidence remains searchable.
DOCX core properties preserve title, creator, subject, description, created timestamp, modified timestamp, and last modified by fields.
EML parser records subject, from, to, cc, date, and message ID headers for RFC 822 email sources.
EML parser prefers plain text body parts and falls back to visible HTML body text when plain text is missing.
EML text-like attachments are extracted with explicit attachment markers while unsupported binary attachments are listed with skip reasons.
CSV parser records delimiter, headers, row count, duplicate header warnings, and truncation status before chunking rows.
CSV row evidence is serialized as header value pairs so structured table data remains searchable in retrieval.
JSON parser emits canonical sorted indented text so object fields can be retrieved with stable formatting.
Invalid JSON raises a parse error and does not create a successful source manifest entry.
PDF parser prefixes extracted text with page labels and records page count in parser metadata.
PDF page parse failures and empty pages are preserved as parser warnings for source-lineage review.
Image ingestion is metadata only and records width, height, MIME type, byte count, and file hash.
Audio ingestion is metadata only and records duration, sample rate, channel count, MIME type, and file hash.
Video ingestion is metadata only and records container facts and duration warnings without semantic video understanding.
Answer traceability requires retrieved chunk IDs, cited chunk IDs, source IDs, retrieval strategy, and export status.
